# BJC HealthCare

> BJC HealthCare is one of the largest nonprofit health systems serving Missouri and Illinois, partnering with Washington University School of Medicine, St. Louis Children's Hospital, and Siteman Cancer Center.

BJC operates 14 hospitals and multiple specialty care centers across the St. Louis metropolitan area and surrounding communities, providing comprehensive medical services including primary care, emergency services, cancer treatment, women's health, pediatrics, and specialized surgical services through BJC Medical Group and WashU Medicine.

## Key Topics

- BJC HealthCare hospitals and medical centers
- Washington University Medicine (WashU Medicine)
- St. Louis Children's Hospital
- Siteman Cancer Center
- BJC Medical Group physician practices
- Barnes-Jewish Hospital system
- Memorial Hospital (Belleville and Shiloh, IL)
- Alton Memorial Hospital
- Christian Hospital
- Primary care and family medicine
- Emergency and pediatric emergency services
- Cancer care and oncology
- Women's health and OBGYN services
- Specialty surgery and outpatient services
- St. Louis and Southern Illinois healthcare

## Major Hospital Locations

- [Alton Memorial Hospital](https://www.bjc.org/locations/alton-memorial-hospital): Acute care hospital in Alton, IL with emergency, cancer services since 1937
- [Memorial Hospital in Shiloh](https://www.bjc.org/locations/memorial-hospital-shiloh): Magnet hospital in Shiloh, IL with emergency, pediatric, cardiac services
- [Childbirth Center at Barnes-Jewish Hospital](https://www.bjc.org/locations/childbirth-center-at-barnesjewish-hospital): Labor, delivery, NICU at Barnes-Jewish Hospital with Children's Hospital

## Cancer Care and Oncology Services

- [Siteman Cancer Center at Northwest HealthCare and WashU Medicine](https://www.bjc.org/locations/siteman-cancer-center-at-northwest-healthcare-and-washu-medicine): Siteman Cancer Center location in Florissant with WashU Medicine
- [WashU Medicine Neurosurgery at Gary C. Werths at Siteman Cancer Center](https://www.bjc.org/locations/washu-medicine-neurosurgery-at-gary-c-werths-at-siteman-cancer-center): Neurosurgery services at Siteman Cancer Center, St. Louis
- [Infusion Center at Christian Hospital](https://www.bjc.org/locations/infusion-center-at-christian-hospital): Outpatient infusion therapy, IV treatment at Christian Hospital, St. Louis

## Primary Care and Family Medicine

- [BJC Medical Group Primary Care at Missouri Baptist Medical Center](https://www.bjc.org/locations/bjc-medical-group-primary-care-at-missouri-baptist-medical-center): Primary care on Missouri Baptist Medical Center campus with lab access
- [Family Care at Christian Hospital](https://www.bjc.org/locations/family-care-at-christian-hospital): Family medicine, primary care at Christian Hospital, St. Louis
- [Missouri Baptist Sullivan Medical Office](https://www.bjc.org/locations/missouri-baptist-sullivan-medical-office): Primary care, urgent care in Sullivan, MO with weekend availability

## Emergency and Pediatric Services

- [Pediatric Emergency Room at Progress West Hospital](https://www.bjc.org/locations/pediatric-emergency-room-at-progress-west-hospital): 24/7 pediatric ER at Progress West with St. Louis Children's physicians

## Specialty Medical Services

- [WashU Medicine Fertility & Reproductive Medicine](https://www.bjc.org/locations/washu-medicine-fertility-reproductive-medicine): IVF, fertility preservation, reproductive medicine in St. Louis
- [BJC Medical Group Healthcare Group for Women](https://www.bjc.org/locations/bjc-medical-group-healthcare-group-for-women): OBGYN, women's health, pregnancy care in St. Louis by Klabi & Kreher
- [BJC Medical Group Endocrinology at Sunset Hills](https://www.bjc.org/locations/bjc-medical-group-endocrinology-at-sunset-hills): Endocrinology clinic at BJC Outpatient Center, Sunset Hills, St. Louis
- [BJC Medical Group Endocrinology of Edwardsville](https://www.bjc.org/locations/bjc-medical-group-endocrinology-of-edwardsville): Diabetes, thyroid, hormone disorder treatment in Edwardsville, IL
- [BJC Medical Group ENT Specialists at Alton](https://www.bjc.org/locations/bjc-medical-group-ent-specialists-at-alton): ENT, audiology, sinus surgery, hearing aids in Alton, IL
- [Sleep Medicine at Barnes-Jewish West County Hospital](https://www.bjc.org/locations/sleep-medicine-at-barnesjewish-west-county-hospital): Sleep disorder treatment at Barnes-Jewish West County Hospital, St. Louis
- [Outpatient Nutritional Services at Memorial Hospital](https://www.bjc.org/locations/outpatient-nutritional-services-at-memorial-hospital): Dietitian, nutrition counseling at Memorial Hospital, Belleville, IL

## Surgical and Orthopedic Services

- [BJC Medical Group Orthopedics & Sports Medicine at Alton](https://www.bjc.org/locations/bjc-medical-group-orthopedics-sports-medicine-at-alton): Orthopedic surgery, sports medicine at Alton Memorial Hospital
- [BJC Medical Group Vascular and Vein Surgery at Edwardsville](https://www.bjc.org/locations/bjc-medical-group-vascular-and-vein-surgery-at-edwardsville): Vascular surgery, aneurysm repair, varicose vein treatment in Edwardsville

## Diagnostic and Imaging Services

- [Imaging at Barnes-Jewish West County Hospital](https://www.bjc.org/locations/imaging-at-barnesjewish-west-county-hospital): Radiology, diagnostic imaging at Barnes-Jewish West County, Creve Coeur
